import json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.run_pickcube_repeat import plan
for seed in [1,2]:
 jobs=plan(seed)
 assert len(jobs)==8 and len({j['id'] for j in jobs})==8
 for job in jobs:
  c=job['command']
  assert c[c.index('--seed')+1]==str(seed)
  assert c[c.index('--output')+1]=='artifacts/'+job['id']
  assert not any('checkpoints/e' in x for x in c)
  if '--resume-checkpoint' in c:assert c[c.index('--resume-checkpoint')+1]==f'checkpoints/pick-seed{seed}-c-001/final.pt'
  if '--total-timesteps' in c:assert c[c.index('--total-timesteps')+1]=='262144'
  assert not any(x=='20000' for x in c)
 Path(f'artifacts/repeat-plan-check-001/seed{seed}.json').write_text(json.dumps(jobs,indent=2))
Path('artifacts/repeat-plan-check-001/result.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(valid=True,seeds=[1,2],jobs_per_seed=8,new_environment_interactions=0,check='Expanded lineage, seeds, budgets, outputs, and no final-test access; not an execution result'),indent=2))
